patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: I have competed in a cage. I have broken this nose twice. And a PEBBLE in my kidney has brought me to my knees. I cannot sit still. This is an eleven. There is no ten anymore.
clinical.presentationShort: 34yo M — sudden severe L flank pain to groin, can't hold still, afebrile.
clinical.presentationLong: 34-year-old male, sudden severe left flank pain radiating to the groin, unable to hold still, no fever.

triageReasoning.summary: This is a painful but physiologically stable presentation expected to require multiple resources for evaluation and symptom control.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: Sudden flank pain radiating to the groin with marked restlessness is concerning and requires prompt treatment, but the patient is afebrile and has stable blood pressure, breathing, and oxygenation without an immediate life threat.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 3 / Acute is appropriate because the patient is stable but is expected to require a multi-resource evaluation and treatment.
keyFindings: Sudden left flank pain radiating to the groin
Stable blood pressure, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation
teachingPoints: A reported pain score alone does not determine the ESI level; overall risk, physiologic stability, and expected resources also matter.
Restlessness is characteristic of colicky pain, while an unstable appearance, fever, hypotension, or other high-risk findings would increase concern.

possibleDiagnoses: Another urinary or abdominal cause of flank pain
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely receive urinalysis, renal imaging, and symptom treatment, with discharge possible if pain is controlled and no infection, obstruction complication, or alternate emergency is identified.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 34-year-old fit man in a gym tank top
aiImageGeneration.pose: half off the chair, unable to find any comfortable position, clutching his left flank
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 34-year-old fit man in a gym tank top, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: half off the chair, unable to find a comfortable position, clutching his left flank, mid-writhe. Expression: grimacing, restless, shifting. Clearly visible: hand clutching the left flank, a body that can't hold still. Overall dramatic pain but vitally stable. No text, no logos.
